results.explanation: Raffle._update enforces destination hygiene by calling _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) so that tickets cannot be owned by protocol contracts incapable of redeeming or refunding them. However, because RaffleFactory deploys clones using deterministic CREATE (Clones.clone), any future Raffle clone address can be precomputed from address(factory) and its nonce before deployment. While undeployed, `to.code.length == 0` and `canonicalFactory.isRaffle(to) == false`, so _isProtocolDestination returns false and `transferFrom` succeeds. Once `RaffleFactory.createRaffle` deploys the sibling Raffle at `to`, `isRaffle[to]` becomes true and the ticket is owned by a Raffle clone that has no function to transfer, redeem, or refund tickets (and would also be blocked by _isProtocolDestination in _transferQuote), permanently locking the associated refund or winning prize in the raffle contract.
